name: Stealth & Shadow
description: Excellence in moving silently, hiding in darkness, and avoiding unwanted detection.

name: First Aid & Triage
description: Knowledge of field medicine to bind wounds, stabilize injuries, and treat basic ailments.

name: Mechanics & Tinkering
description: Ability to disable locks, repair mechanical contraptions, and assemble jury-rigged tools.

name: Ancient Lore
description: Deep understanding of forgotten histories, arcane runes, and mythic monsters.

name: Wilderness Survival
description: Proficiency in tracking beasts, foraging edible flora, and constructing temporary shelters.

name: Battle Mage
description: Get a +3 to any spell cast with Fight stat

name: Healer
description: Get a +3 to any spell cast with Grit stat

name: Assasin
description: Spend an Adversity Token to make a strike a critical hit

name: Lucky
description: Spend 2 Adversity Tokens to reroll a stat check

name: Cool Under Pressure
description: Spend 1 adversity token to take half of your die's value instead of rolling on a snap decision

name: Easygoing
description: Gain 2 adversity tokens when you fail instead of 1

name: Loyal
description: Each Adversity Token you spend to help your friends give them +2 instead of +1

name: Intuitive
description: Spend 1 Adversity Token to ask the GM about your surroundings, an NPC or the like and the GM must answer honestly

name: Prepared
description: Spend 2 Adversity Tokens to just happen to have a commonplace item with you

name: Quick Healing
description: You recover from injuries more quickly and don't suffer lasting effects from most injuries

name: Treasure Hunter
description: Spend 1 Adversity Token to find a useful item in your surroundings

name: Unassuming
description: Spend 2 Adversity Tokens to remain unseen within reason (GM discretion)

name: Resilient
description: When spending AT to boost a check against a spell that targets you, each AT is worth +2 instead of +1.

name: Wild Speak
description: You can communicate with any animal whose species you have knowledge of.
